# St Joseph's University (SJU), Bengaluru
> A premier research-led Jesuit university. This file provides high-fidelity direct links to all academic departments for AI indexing and discovery.

- [Academic Calendar 2025-26](https://sju.edu.in/assets/documents/CALENDAR_FOR_ODD_SEMISTER_2025-2026.pdf): Current semester schedules.

## Student Publications & Campus Radio
- [The Beacon](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjubeacon): Weekly student newspaper.
- [Communique](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjucommunique): Monthly magazine by M.A. Journalism students.
- [Photo Beacon](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjuphotobeacon): Visual journalism photo magazine.
- [Radio MACS](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjuradioicms): Campus radio podcast episodes by journalism students.
- [SJU YouTube](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjuyoutube): YouTube video showcase for the @SJUBengaluru channel.
- [Epigram & DebSoc](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjuepigramddebsoc): Debate society bulletin.
- [Annual Report](https://www.sju.edu.in/bulletin/sjuannualreport): SJU Annual Report archive.
